title: From Core to Detail: Unsupervised Disentanglement with Entropy-Ordered Flows
abstract: arXiv:2602.06940v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The unsupervised discovery of features that are both semantically meaningful and stable across runs remains a central challenge in representation learning. We introduce entropy-ordered flows (EOFlows), a normalizing flow (NF) framework that augments standard maximum likelihood training with an orthogonality regularizer on the decoder Jacobian. The regularizer is rooted in Independent Mechanism Analysis and encourages geometric disentanglement, and a stochastic estimator makes it tractable at image scale (CelebA at $D=2352$ and $12288$). Learned features form near-orthogonal curvilinear coordinates and can be ordered by their $\textit{explained (manifold) entropy}$ after training, analogous to the ranking by explained variance in PCA, which turns EOFlows into a non-linear generalization of PCA. translated_title: 从核心到细节：基于熵排序流的无监督解耦
translated_abstract: 在表示学习中，无监督地发现既具有语义意义又在多次运行间保持稳定的特征仍然是一个核心挑战。我们提出了熵排序流（EOFlows），这是一个归一化流（NF）框架，它在标准的最大似然训练基础上，增加了对解码器雅可比矩阵的正交性正则项。该正则项植根于独立机制分析（Independent Mechanism Analysis），能够促进几何上的解耦，并且借助随机估计器，使其在图像规模下（CelebA 数据集，D=2352 和 12288）也可以被有效计算。学到的特征形成近似正交的曲线坐标系，并且可以在训练后按照其解释（流形）熵进行排序，这类似于 PCA 中按解释方差进行排序的方式，从而使 EOFlows 成为 PCA 的非线性推广。EOFlows 识别出的稳定特征比现有方法多一个数量级，并且这些特征会以可区分的类别形式出现（gl…
tldr: EOFlows 通过在归一化流的最大似然训练中加入解码器雅可比矩阵的正交性正则项，实现无监督几何解耦，学到的特征可按解释熵排序，使其成为 PCA 的非线性推广，并能识别出比现有方法多一个数量级的稳定特征。
en_tdlr: EOFlows augments normalizing flows with an orthogonality regularizer on the decoder Jacobian to achieve unsupervised geometric disentanglement, yielding features rankable by explained entropy—a nonlinear generalization of PCA—and identifying an order of magnitude more stable features than existing methods.
